name: Foum El Bouir
hero_subtitle: Atlantic wave spot on the ocean side of the Dakhla peninsula.

overview.title: Open ocean after the lagoon
overview.p1: Foum El Bouir sits on the Atlantic side of the peninsula — a change of mood from the lagoon’s flat water to open ocean swell and wider horizons.
overview.p2: Riders come for waves; others come for the walk and the contrast. Conditions change with swell and wind; ask locally before entering the water.
overview.p3: Bring sun protection and water; services are lighter than at the main lagoon camps.

q1.question: How far is Foum El Bouir from the lagoon camps?
q1.answer: A drive across or along the peninsula. Confirm transfer time with your base.

q2.question: Is it beginner-friendly?
q2.answer: Ocean swell is more demanding than lagoon flat water. Beginners usually start on the lagoon.

q3.question: Can I swim at Foum El Bouir?
q3.answer: Only when conditions are clearly safe. This is open Atlantic, not sheltered lagoon water.

q4.question: Are there facilities?
q4.answer: Limited compared with lagoon camps. Pack water, shade and what you need.

q5.question: Worth visiting without surfing?
q5.answer: Yes, for the open coastline and a change of landscape from the lagoon.
